conbody.p: Top gaps, beside the sections, lists the first few artifacts that need attention, worst first — failing requirements, then those without a verification method, without a test case, and so on — each with the reason. All opens the full list, grouped by kind of gap (for example requirements without a verification method, or without any verifying test). An empty list means full coverage. When agents have proposals waiting, the card says how many and links to them; otherwise it points you to the agents that can draft test cases.

Unverified (demonstration, analysis, inspection) is the section for requirements whose method is not test: nothing links a test case to them, so they can never show up as "without a test case". They stay listed until the requirement is marked verified, which is the same point at which the coverage rollup turns them from uncovered into verified-manually.
